title: Mike's Mines
body:
Mike's Mines

Mike's Mines is a location where players can mine several rocks for ore. At the entrance to Mike's Mines, an NPC named Mike Miner sells an array of low-tier explosives that can be used to access

hidden and blocked-off areas around the map. A pillow and rusty axe can be found behind Mike, but neither can be interacted with.

The Mines are shrouded in darkness with only a vestigial amount of light coming from the hanging lanterns, so it is recommended that players use the headlights of their car or a flashlight while venturing into Mike's Mines. Only Lightslate, Darkslate, Smokeslate, and Beigeslate nodes can spawn in Mike's Mines. It is more common for certain ore types to spawn in Mike's Mines compared to the Finlay Grasslands, notably Mythril and Gold nodes.

Notable Locations

Mike's Mines can now be divided into several sublocations, with one major location that is connected directly to Mike's Mines. This unique location is the:

  • Magma Caves, found at an explodable entrance at the center of the Low Mines.

Mike's Mines also has less important but still useful biomes. These include:

  • Mike's Mines (known simply as the Mines)
  • Low Mines, located deeper inside the Mines.
  • Quartz Cave, located directly left from the main entrance.
  • Underground Lake, located directly right from the main entrance.

Mike's Mines (the "Mines")

  • Immediately accessible from all entrances on the surface to Mike's Mines.
  • Spawns Beigeslate and Lightslate. Marble also spawns here when driving closer to the Quartz Cave.
  • Raw Copper and Raw Iron nodes spawn on the walls and ceiling in particular areas, useful for farming large amounts of these metals.

Low Mines

  • The Low Mines are continuous with the normal Mines, except denoted by a darker atmosphere and louder, more cacophonous soundtrack.
  • Spawns Darkslate and Smokeslate in addition to Beigeslate and Lightslate.
  • Raw Tin and Raw Gold nodes spawn on the walls and ceiling in particular areas, useful for farming large amounts of these metals.
  • Has the entrance to the Magma Caves.

Quartz Cave

  • From the main entrance of Mike's Mines, follow the in-game map by taking the left pathway to reach the Quartz Cave.
  • Spawns Marble with guaranteed ores of either Quartz or Rosa Flama Quartz.

Underground Lake

  • Has several entrances across Finlay; allows access to Mike's Mines from Flowering Meadows and the Finlay Taiga.
  • Has a potential location for the Pirate Boat shop.
  • One of the spawn locations of Celestial Flowers.
  • The only spawn location of Luminescent Kelp.

Stores

Finlay Stores

Mike's Mines has two stores:

  • Mike's Mines Shop, located at the main entrance to Mike's Mines. The following chart lists the items that Miner Mike offers.
  • The Pirate Boat shop, a moving shop that sells high-tier explosives, located in one of the offshoots of the Underground Lake.

Quests and Secrets

  • Red Button to activate quest pedestals is located here for the Uncertain Pickaxe quest, - you need to use the scaffolding on the ceiling to parkour to it.
  • Burning Skull can be made in Magma Caves.

Lumberwork

With the name, Mike's Mines, it is immediately clear this area is not intended for lumberwork. However, there are still two tree types (not counting Magma Caves) located in the Underground Lake of Mike's Mines:

  • Kelp, common rarity, underwater in the Underground Lake.
  • Luminescent Kelp, common rarity, underwater in the Underground Lake.

Mining

Mike's Mines Stone Types

Mike's Mines is an early-game mine used for farming common ores and stones. It is more convenient than farming nodes on the surface of Finlay as this area is almost entirely dedicated to ores. Using a Metal Detector allows you to easily identify what ore, if any, occupies a stone node. Using a Flashlight or your vehicle's headlights is a useful strategy to identify ores early-game, as Mike's Mines (and the Low Mines especially) are much darker compared to the surface.

On another note: the "raw" ore variant (for Copper, Iron, Tin, and Gold) spawn on the walls and ceilings - making them much more difficult to mine. You can sometimes get lucky and mine these nodes if they spawn close enough to the ground, but the nodes that spawn on the ceiling require either a Gravity Coil (or Fusion Coil), a taller vehicle to stand/jump off from (such as the new Freyliner Transporter vehicle), or the Boom Blaster from Dugg's Digging whilst using Sticky Bombs from the River Shop as ammunition. These mid/late game nodes are extremely useful for farming these four specific materials; the entire node is guaranteed to be a material depending on the location.

  • Beigeslate, common rarity, early-game stone, found near everywhere in Oaklands.
  • Lightslate, common rarity, early-game stone, found near everywhere in Oaklands.
  • Smokeslate, common rarity, early-game stone, found most often in the Low Mines, but spawns commonly elsewhere.
  • Darkslate, common rarity, early-game stone, found most often in the Low Mines, but spawns commonly elsewhere.
  • Chalkyslate, common rarity, early-game stone, near entrance to Quartz Cave, but also spawns in Ferwater.
  • Marble, common rarity, early-game stone, in Quartz Cave, but spawns in certain areas on Finlay too. If in this cave, it is guaranteed to contain: Rosa Flama Quartz and Quartz.
  • Raw Copper, common rarity, mid-game stone, in Mike’s Mines on walls and ceiling.
  • Raw Iron, common rarity, mid-game stone, in Mike’s Mines on walls and ceiling.
  • Raw Tin, common rarity, mid-game stone, in Low Mines on walls and ceiling.
  • Raw Gold, common rarity, mid-game stone, in Low Mines on walls and ceiling.
  • Blue, Red, and Brown Clay, common rarity, early/mid-game stone, underwater in the Underground Lake.

Quick Stone-Ore Summary:

Mike's Mines Ores Sorted by Stone Type
Stone Type Potential Ore Spawns Other Concerns
Beigeslate: Pyrite, Copper, Gold.
Lightslate: Iron, Ink, Mythril. Ink is less common than on the surface of Finlay.
Smokeslate: Lithium, Mythril.
Darkslate: Tin.
Chalkyslate: Iron, Lithium. May be inaccurate - still looking into it.

Blue, Red, and Brown Clay: Blue, Red, and Brown Opal. Rare in Mike's Mines. Easy to find in River Caves and Desert Oasis.

Mike's Mines Ore Types (Detailed)

Ores spawn in a particular stone type. Due to an update to the way in which ores and stone nodes are generated, different ores can not spawn on the same node - for example, Pyrite can not spawn on Lightslate. Using a Metal Detector allows you to easily identify what ore, if any, occupies a stone node. The rarity listed depends on the ore's sell value and its difficulty in retrieving it. This is a comprehensive list of all ores that could spawn in Mike's Mines disregarding glitches:

  • Copper, common rarity, found in Beigeslate.
  • Pyrite, common rarity, found in Beigeslate.
  • Gold, common rarity, found in Beigeslate.
  • Iron, common rarity, found in Lightslate.
  • Ink, common rarity, found in Lightslate (Low spawn rate in Mike's Mines).
  • Tin, common rarity, in Darkslate.
  • Lithium, common rarity, in Smokeslate.
  • Mythril, uncommon rarity, found in Darkslate and Smokeslate.
  • Quartz, common rarity, in Marble.
  • Rosa Quartz, common rarity, in Marble.
  • Blue, Red, and Brown Opal, uncommon rarity, in Blue, Red, and Brown Clay (low spawn rate in normal waters; guaranteed spawn in Desert Oasis and certain areas of the River Caves)

Foraging

Once more; with the name, Mike's Mines, it is immediately clear this area is not intended for foraging. However, there is one forageable (not counting Magma Caves) in the Underground Lake of Mike's Mines:

  • Celestial Flowers, on the foliage hanging from the ceiling above and around the Underground Lake.

Trivia

  • Behind The small shack you can find a rock with an X on top, which can be exploded to gain access to buying the Sun Dry Vinyl.
  • During the Halloween 2023 event Candycorn and Sweetstone were able to be found inside of Mike's Mines
